name: weekly-sync
description: A weekly team sync (English), with a raised-then-parked topic. Written for #101/#136; synthetic.

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: Okay, let's get started. Thanks everyone for joining the weekly sync.

lines.speaker: Bob
lines.text: Sure. Can you hear me okay? My mic was acting up earlier.

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: Yes, you're fine. So first up, I wanted to go over where we are with the mobile release.

lines.speaker: Bob
lines.text: Right, so the build is green, QA signed off on Tuesday, and we're planning to push it to the store on Friday.

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: One thing on that, the crash on older Android versions is fixed but I'd like one more day of beta data before we roll to a hundred percent.

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: That's fair. Let's do a staged rollout, ten percent Friday, and widen on Monday if crash rates look normal.

lines.speaker: Bob
lines.text: Works for me.

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: Next, hiring. We still have the backend role open.

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: I did three interviews this week. One strong candidate, she has a lot of Postgres experience, I'd like to move her to the onsite.

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: Great, let's schedule that for next week. Bob, can you be on the panel?

lines.speaker: Bob
lines.text: Yes, put me down for the system design part.

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: Okay. By the way, the coffee machine on the third floor is broken again, so don't bother going up there.

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: Ha, noted.

lines.speaker: Bob
lines.text: Should we talk about the cloud bill? It went up quite a bit last month.

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: Let's park that, I don't have the numbers yet. Maybe next week.

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: Also I wanted to mention the customer from Lyon complained again about export to PDF being slow.

lines.speaker: Bob
lines.text: We profiled it, the slow part is the font embedding. I have a fix that caches the fonts, it brings a fifty page export from twenty seconds down to three.

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: Nice, let's get that into the release after this one. Carol, can you let the customer know it's coming?

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: Will do.

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: Anything else? Okay, I think that's it, thanks all.

points.text: Mobile release date and rollout plan
Backend hiring: next steps for candidates
Cloud costs: why the bill went up and how to cut it
Who is on the interview panel
Customer churn in the enterprise segment
